facts.business: Gujarat Natural Resources Limited is an Indian listed company engaged in oil and gas exploration and production through its subsidiaries.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties include loans granted to and received from subsidiary GNRL Oil & Gas (I) Pvt Ltd (closing balance Rs 12,733 lakh), remuneration payable to directors and KMPs, and trade receivables from entities where KMPs exercise significant influence. All transactions are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013.
